titulo: "White-Out Lung" Following Veno-Venous Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO) Initiation for Acute Refractory Respiratory Failure From Obstructive Lung Disease: A Case Series

fig.caption: a) CXR before initiation of ECMO; b) CXR after initiation of ECMO and the lung rest strategy, with the red arrow showing left lung opacity; c) CXR after changes in ventilator settings, with the green arrow showing resolution of the left lung opacity.CXR: chest X-ray; ECMO: extracorporeal membrane oxygenation
